name: Caesar Weed
desc: Caesar Weed (Urena lobata): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 25 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Urena lobata, commonly known as Caesarweed or Congo jute, is a tender perennial, variable, erect, ascendant shrub or subshrub measuring up to 0.5 meters (1.6 ft) to 2.5 meters (8.2 ft) tall.
